info.name: Dooit API — Customer Manual Import
info.description:
Staff-side manual import of an INDIVIDUAL customer (in-branch onboarding).

**Flow**: staff fill an OCR-prefilled form → POST /customer/manual-import → customer + audit journey created → Sumsub chain (applicant → upload docs → request check) runs in the background → webhook updates KYC status (GREEN auto-triggers AML).

**Setup**
1. Set `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:5000`).
2. Run **Auth / Login** to populate `{{token}}` — the endpoint requires role admin/client/branch/manager/officer.
3. Send **Manual Import — Individual**. Tenant (client/branch) is resolved from the session; only tenant-less admin sessions may pass `clientId`/`branchId` in the body.

**Responses**
- `201` created — `data.sumsub` is `queued` (docs present, runSumsubCheck ≠ false) or `skipped`
- `200` existing customer linked to this tenant (`relationAdded: true`, Sumsub not re-run)
- `409` customer already exists for this client/branch — `data.customerId` links to the record
- `400` validation / tenant errors

variable.description: Base URL of the Dooit API server
JWT Bearer token — set automatically by Auth / Login

request.description: Creates the customer, writes the audit journey (personal_form / id_document / selfie steps), then runs the Sumsub chain in the background. Returns 201 with data.sumsub = "queued".
Minimum viable import: given_name + one contact. No documents → Sumsub skipped, kycStatus stays "pending".

item.name: Manual Import — admin with explicit tenant

request.description: clientId/branchId in the body are honored ONLY when the session has no client context (platform admin). branchId is verified to belong to clientId.
Re-send after the full import. Same tenant → 409 with data.customerId. Different tenant session → 200 with relationAdded: true (Sumsub not re-run).
